A: FFI: says autumn-2026 calls are planned and exact dates are not published; ffisweden.se shows the autumn round closed 15 Sep 2026 with 108 applications
Tillämpad AI för industrin: 'oftast 3–12 MSEK per projekt'; the call allowed 2–10 MSEK per project
Eurostars: calls autumn 2025 the latest Swedish round; Vinnova has since run spring 2026 (Call 10) and autumn 2026 (Call 11, closed 10 Sep 2026). The 5 MSEK cap is still right
Innovativa Startups: 'färre än 10 anställda'; the official rule is at most 10 full-time equivalents
Commercial GPU prices (L40S about 1 USD/h, H100 2–4 USD/h at specialist clouds, 7–12 USD/h at AWS/Google/Azure); the only source is Hostinger, a third party
Avancerad digitalisering 'pågår 2025–2027'; the program site only says state funding runs through 2027
